Full summary: Built v2.0.0-beta.1 scope (V1-V5) on branch v2.0-beta: engines 22.13 + CI 22/24 + prerelease dist-tag routing, auto backend resolution with legacy nudge, SUPPORTED_CONFIG_VERSION=2 with migrate stamps, init stamping, opt-in auto-migrate, upgrade docs. Full gates green (1063 tests, SOAK_SCALE=5).
Decisions: [object Object]; [object Object]; [object Object]; [object Object]
Findings: Blast radius of the auto default was exactly the migrate-test fixtures: filesConfig()/createStores({...DEFAULT_CONFIG}) in test/migrate/*.ts seeded 'legacy' state that now routed to sqlite on fresh temp dirs. Fixed by pinning storage.backend: files in 5 test files; no production code weakened.; One stale assertion outside migrate tests: test/file-store.test.ts expected 'version: 1' in fresh config.yml — updated to expect the stamped version matching sqliteAvailable().; src/migrate/auto.ts defers importing forward.js until a migration actually runs, so the common no-opt-in startup never pays the migrate module chain's parse cost.; The multiwriter soak's 'skipped' entry at SOAK_SCALE=5 is the no-dist placeholder describe, not a real case — both file and sqlite soak cases ran and passed against freshly built dist/ with the new resolution code.
